subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt the open full fork fix, land the narrower compaction PR first, or create a fresh same-repo repair that covers both reported gaps?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but this issue already has an open full closing fork PR plus a narrower open same-repo PR, so automation should not create another competing implementation until maintainers choose the route.

options.title: Adopt or replace full fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/473 as source material or recreate it in openclaw/openclaw so both isolated-cron matching and compaction-counter preservation land together.

options.title: Land compaction first
options.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100553 for the compaction-reset gap while keeping this issue open for the isolated-session cron gap.

options.title: Wait for fork refresh
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts, proof, and checks before deciding.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace full fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/473 as source material or recreate it in openclaw/openclaw so both isolated-cron matching and compaction-counter preservation land together.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior same-session cron suppression and refactored the current reminder-guard helper surface, making them the strongest routing owner for the adopt-or-replace choice.
